summary.text: Darin Tompkins is a nonpartisan candidate for Nebraska State Senate District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Rick Holdcroft.
Tompkins has a career in science-based manufacturing and finished first in the May 12, 2026 primary with 52.9 percent of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Darin Tompkins said in a Ballotpedia survey that he grew up in a small rural community, the son of an electrician and volunteer firefighter and a city clerk.
He earned a bachelor's degree from South Dakota State University in 1992, and said he holds degrees in microbiology and biology.
Tompkins reported more than 30 years in science-based manufacturing, rising from quality control to executive director of an animal health vaccine plant in Omaha.
He said he has a blended family of six children, four of whom graduated from Gretna High School, and volunteers with Habitat for Humanity and local food drives.
Tompkins named financial relief for the middle class, targeted property tax relief and upholding the will of voters on ballot initiatives as his key campaign messages.
